name: False alarm: the refrigerator clunks
notes: N1110 (rhythm, item 5). Played by FS47Calm, indoors, at most once a week. The low hum in the room stops, something clunks, then the hum starts up again. Silence first, then the ordinary reveal. No finding, no danger, no camera.

beats.text: Just the refrigerator. It does that.
